applicability: Two-independent-measurement significance z-score checking whether a claimed product difference exceeds measurement noise
assumptions: each measurement uncertainty is an independent, approximately normal standard error
the two measurements were taken under otherwise matched conditions
excluded: full comparative studies with repeated measurements
uncertainty: Standard statistical hypothesis-testing arithmetic (uncertainty propagation); hand-verified before use (x1=85.0,u1=0.5,x2=83.0,u2=0.5 -> z=2.828; x1=85.0,u1=2.0,x2=84.0,u2=2.0 -> z=0.354).
limits_policy: A non-significant result is reported as inconclusive, never as proof of equivalence.
